products.name: QIDI S-White
products.composition: QIDI S-White Quick-Remove Support Material (p. 1, as the sheet states it)

items.text: QIDI S-White can be used in dual printhead FDM printers or 2-in/1-out FDM printers.
QIDI S-White Quick-Remove Support Material is compatible with the following QIDI industrial grade material products.
The QIDI S-White does not require the use of water or solvents during the use process, does not produce water pollution, and is safe and environmentally friendly.
S-White Quick-Remove Support Material does not require the use of water or solvents during the removal of the support and does not produce water pollution, which is safe and environmentally friendly.

During the annealing process, QIDI S-White can play the role of supporting the body material, reducing the dimensional deformation of the body material and improving the mechanical properties of the body material.

QIDI S-White very easy to absorb moisture within the environment, and printing after absorbing moisture will result ozzing, extruding with bubbles and rough surface appearance, thus reducing print quality.
It is recommended that put the filament into a dry box (humidity below 15%) immediately after opening the QIDI S-White vacuum foil bag for printing.
Please put the unused filament back into the original aluminum foil bag for sealed storage.
After the material is damp, there will be more printing ozzing, bubbles extruded and rough printing surface.
Please dry the filament in an oven at 80-100℃ for 4-6h to restore the printing quality of QIDI S-White.
It is recommended to use hardened steel and above grade nozzles made by Phaetus, which can effectively improve the print quality.

QIDI S-White can provide a moderate bond strength to the body material through formulation and process modifications, which ensures that the body material can be molded to the support surface and can be easily separated from the support surface of the body material during removal of the support.
QIDI S-White has dramatically reduced its own interlayer bond strength through formulation and process modifications, and can be easily teared apart during removal process.
QIDI S-White Quick-Remove Support Material can achieve fast and easy peeling by adjusting the bonding strength to the support surface of the body material and the bonding strength of S-White itself.
Besides, it is recommended that the thickness of the heating block is longer 12mm.

In dual-extruder printing mode, the material in the standby nozzle will deteriorate due to prolonged heating, and the deteriorated material needs to be squeezed out before the print nozzle is switched, so it is necessary to use the Wipe wall or Wipe tower function in the slicing software.
After the printing is completed, the printed part can be annealed and then the QIDI S-White removal step can be performed.
Annealing conditions: set according to the requirements of the body material.
